texts.preamble: Prashant Mishra Nominee For Itc Ltd. And ... vs Food Safety Officer State Of M.P. And ... on 14 March, 2018 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Wp-9869-2013 (Prashant Mishra Nominee For Itc Ltd. And Anr. Vs Food Safety Officer State Of M.P. And Anr.) 3 Indore, Dated : 14-03-2018
texts.facts: e The respondents have filed an application for vacating the ad stay mainly on the ground that the petitioner is having remedy of Pr appeal under Section 46(4) of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, hence, stay be vacated and petition be dismissed. a Shri Bagadiya has produced copy of the order dated 01.02.2016 hy passed by the coordinate bench of this Court in W.P.No.2665/2013, by ad which the similar application for vacating of stay filed on the ground M of availability of alternate efficacious remedy has been rejected. rt "I.A.No.309/16, an application for dismissal of the petition filed by the State primarily raises three grounds. The first being that the petitioner can ou approach the Food Safely Appellate Tribunal under Section 70 of the Food C Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (in short the Act, 2006) against the order of Adjudicating Officer under Section 68 of the Act.
texts.arguments: Further, it is contended that h ig vide Annexure-A/2 (alongwith I.A.No.309/16), the coordinate bench at principal seat in W.P.No.19958/13 has relegated the petitioner therein to avail H the remedy of appeal and lastly by relying on Annexure-A/3, it is contended that similar petitions have been dismissed by the single bench at the principal seat. The present petition assails the prosecution launched against the petitioner and also sanction granted for prosecuting the petitioner under the said Act, 2006 on various grounds. In the instant case, the petitioner's product, i.e. cream biscuits have been found to be misbranded.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Further, it is contended that h ig vide Annexure-A/2 (alongwith I.A.No.309/16), the coordinate bench at principal seat in W.P.No.19958/13 has relegated the petitioner therein to avail H the remedy of appeal and lastly by relying on Annexure-A/3, it is contended that similar petitions have been dismissed by the single bench at the principal seat. The present petition assails the prosecution launched against the petitioner and also sanction granted for prosecuting the petitioner under the said Act, 2006 on various grounds. In the instant case, the petitioner's product, i.e. cream biscuits have been found to be misbranded.
